articles.image_title: Proteste in Südafrika: A major demonstration against undocumented immigration takes place outside the Soweto Theatre and adjacent Jabulani Amphitheatre in Soweto, Johannesburg, as part of a wave of protests ahead of a reported June 30, 2026 deadline linked to anti-foreigner sentiment. Organisers marched under slogans including #Abahambe (“They must go”) and Khuphuka SOWETO (“Rise Soweto”), calling for stricter enforcement of immigration laws and increased verification of documentation in the township. The march proceeded through Soweto toward the Moroka Police Station, where a memorandum of demands was handed over to SAPS officials. While organisers framed the action around crime and service delivery concerns, the protest reflects broader national tensions over migration and undocumented foreign nationals. Soweto, Johannesburg, Gauteng, South Africa, June 28, 2026. Photo by Ilan Godfrey for Die Zeit.
